result.topic_en: A page of dated diary entries from May–July 1796 recording results on recurrent series, divisor sums, a new proof of the quadratic reciprocity law ('golden theorem'), and the theorem that every number is a sum of three triangular numbers.

methods.what: The recurrence relation (scale) of a series that is variously recurrent is a second-order function of the component scales
methods.quote:
Scalam simplicem in {+seriebus+} [-fractionibus-] varia[?] in recurrentibus
esse functionem similem secundi ordinis scalarum
componentium

methods.what: Asymptotic comparisons involving primes and divisors
methods.quote:
Comparationes infinitorum in numeris primis &
factoribus.

methods.what: Recurrence scale for series whose terms are products or arbitrary functions of terms of several series
methods.quote:
Scala ubi seriei termini sunt producta vel adeo functiones
quaecunque terminorum quotcunque serierum

methods.what: Sum of divisors of a composite number, with general factor (a^{n+1}-1)/(a-1)
methods.quote:
Formula pro summa factorum numeri cuiusvis
compositi f. gen. $\frac{a^{n+1}-1}{a-1}$

methods.what: Sum of the periods (of decimal expansions) over all numbers below a modulus, with general factor ((n+1)a-na)a^{n-1}
methods.quote:
Periodorum summa omnibus [-infra-] modulum numeris
pro elementis sumtis fact. gen. $((n+1)a-na)a^{n-1}$

methods.what: Asymptotic sum of divisor sums: equals π²/6 times the sum of the numbers
methods.quote: Factorum summae in infinitum $= \frac{\pi\pi}{6}$ sum. Num.

methods.what: New a priori proof of the quadratic reciprocity law ('golden theorem')
methods.quote:
Nova theorematis aurei demonstratio a priori
toto coelo diversa eaque haud parum elegans

methods.what: Each partition of a number a into two squares gives a form separable into two squares
methods.quote:
Quaeque partitio numeri a in bina □ dat formam in
bina □ separabilitem.

methods.what: Every number is the sum of three triangular numbers
Euler's determination of forms in which composite numbers are contained more than once
methods.quote:
Determinatio Euleriana formarum in quibus numeri compo
siti plus una vice continentur

methods.what: Principles for composing scales of variously recurrent series
methods.quote: Principia componendi scalas serierum variatim recurrentium

methods.what: Euler's method for the relation between rectangles of segments of intersecting chords in conic sections, extended to all curves
methods.quote:
Methodus Euleriana pro demonstranda relatione inter [-producta-]
rectangula sub segmentis rectarum sese secantium in sectionibus
conicis ad omnes curvas applicatur

items.quote:
Coepi de multiplicatoribus (in formis divisorum
formarum qu.) connexis cogitare
items.english: I began to think about the multipliers connected (in the forms of divisors of quadratic forms).

items.quote:
[-Summa trium quadratorum continue proportionalium num
quam primus esse potest[?]
items.english: (Struck out) The sum of three squares in continued proportion can never be prime.
Eureka: every number = triangle + triangle + triangle.

items.quote: Factorum summae in infinitum $= \frac{\pi\pi}{6}$ sum. Num.
items.english: The sums of divisors, in the limit, equal π²/6 times the sum of the numbers.
